name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet

description: Peony and rose gather in a fresh, airy bouquet, lifted by bergamot and finished with clean, soft musk. Gentle, springlike and uncomplicated.

description: Mandarin opens a rounded jasmine heart, then amberwood brings a creamy, glowing warmth. Floral and citrusy at first, softer and deeper as it dries.

name: Miss Dior Rose N'Roses

description: Bitter orange gives a zesty edge to a bright rose, with tonka bean adding a sweet, soft warmth underneath. Playful and fresh.

description: Bergamot flickers over orange blossom, resting on soft, creamy musk. A white floral that feels clean, luminous and quietly sweet.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum

name: Eau de Lierre

description: Galbanum opens green and sharp, cyclamen adds a cool floral note, and rosewood gives a light, woody finish. Like ivy on a damp wall.

name: Eau de Minthé
